entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [LSP] Allow explicitly defining which solution or list of projects the language server should load #85794
  • Special-case collection expressions of `ImmutableArray` of 1-4 elements #85793
  • [Navigate To] never considers the symbol under the caret #85791
  • [Navigate To] ranks a result from the active project no higher than one from across the solution #85790

Closed

  • Lifted relational operators returning true should inform nullability tracking that neither operand can be null #56517
    Backlog

PullRequests

Updated

  • Normalize interceptor argument ref kinds for reduced extension calls #85760
  • Avoid dereferencing a reference assigned to a discard #85750
    Area-Compilers
  • Let F# hand Find All References an already classified line #85281
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Sort F# Navigate To results the way C# and VB results are sorted #85280
    VSCode
  • Optimize array Where spreads for mutable list interfaces #85777
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality, Feature - Collection Expressions
  • Test that a diagnostic without a help link has no code description #85740
    VSCode
  • Fix CrefCompletionProvider crash on cref type parameter return types #85789
    Community, VSCode
